evidence.description: The notification center dependency is hard-coded to the global default instance.
The globally obtained notification center performs the operational service of posting state-change notifications.
dispatchAuthState directly accesses another service through EcosiaAuthWindowRegistry.shared to retrieve registered windows.

candidates.explanation: The actor obtains operational dependencies directly from NotificationCenter.default and EcosiaAuthWindowRegistry.shared rather than receiving them through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary. It uses these services to post notifications and retrieve registered windows.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access
